import React from 'react' function ApplicationHeader({ application }) { return (
{/* ------------------------------------------------- TOP ROW -------------------------------------------------- */}
{application?.status || 'INPROCESS'} {application?.applied_at || '-'}
{/* ------------------------------------------------- AGENT ASSIGNMENT -------------------------------------------------- */}
Agent Assigned: {application?.agent?.name ? `${application.agent.name} is handling this lead` : 'No agent assigned'}
{/* ------------------------------------------------- APPLICATION SUMMARY -------------------------------------------------- */}
{/* Loan Type */}

Loan Type

{application?.loan_type_label || application?.loan_type || '-'}

{/* Customer */}

Customer

{application?.customer?.name || '-'}

{/* Phone */}

Phone

{application?.customer?.phone || '-'}

{/* RM */}

RM

{application?.rm?.name || '-'}

{/* ------------------------------------------------- ACTIONS -------------------------------------------------- */}
{/* Status */} {/* Agent */}
) } export default ApplicationHeader
